subject: POC micro-extension: usage cap vs. single-month rebate
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rao <maya@harmoniahealth.com>, Ben Strauss <ben@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC micro-extension: usage cap vs. single-month rebate

Hi Maya / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. I took a look with David at your recent token burn and the engineering notes you shared. Two quick options that will keep the POC moving without requiring a formal ratecard amendment:

- Option A (timeboxed extension): +2 weeks POC, same rate, one-time cap on peak concurrent requests (we'd reserve an extra 1k concurrent slots for the extension).
- Option B (single-month rebate): no duration change, we apply a one-time 25% rebate on the next invoice (applies to usage over your normal baseline).

Both options include the same success criteria we agreed (10k validated calls, latency under 600ms P95 for the inference pipeline). If you prefer Option A we can add a short addendum (POC_Addendum_v2.pdf attached) to extend the milestone window; for Option B we can do an invoice credit and skip the addendum.

Quick ask: which path would you prefer by EOD Thursday 11/20 so we can lock capacity and update finance? I can loop in legal if you want the addendum right away.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_Addendum_v2.pdf (1 page summary), SOW-Harmonia.docx (clean copy)

From: Maya Rao <maya@harmoniahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Strauss <ben@harmoniahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC micro-extension: usage cap vs. single-month rebate

Kimberly —

Appreciate the options. A couple of constraints from our side: engineering wants an extra 10 business days (we're +1 week on integration tasks), and procurement is pushing for no contractual changes this quarter (they prefer a billing credit).

If we go with Option B (rebate), would Redwood consider a 30% rebate on the next invoice instead of 25%? That would get procurement to greenlight the internal sign-offs without an addendum.

Also, can you confirm the rebate will be applied as a line-item credit (not a delayed refund) and that it won't affect the SLA calculations? Ben, fyi in case procurement has follow-ups.

Best —
Maya
Director of Product, Harmonia Health
maya@harmoniahealth.com

Maya —

Quick follow from SE / finance: we can do a 30% one-time rebate on the next invoice, with two guardrails we need to confirm:

1) Rebate applies only to usage above the baseline month (we'll compare against your average usage over the prior 30 days).
2) Rebate won't change SLAs or reset any uptime calculations — it's purely a billing credit.

If procurement insists on zero-contract-change language, this is feasible but we do need a short note from Harmonia confirming the baseline month window and a PO number to apply the credit. If you'd rather avoid procurement entirely, Option A (+10 business days) is doable but it will require the addendum and Legal sign-off (Olga is CC'd).

If you confirm "30% rebate, apply to usage over baseline month, PO # if possible," we can schedule the credit to hit the invoice dated 12/01 and lock the extra burst slots for the remainder of November.

—David
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai

Maya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can confirm the 30% one-time rebate applied as a line-item credit on the 12/01 invoice. It will be limited to usage above your November baseline (finance will calculate the baseline window and include a short worksheet). No SLA changes.

Two logistics:
- If procurement can share a PO#, send it to invoices@redwood.ai and CC me so we can code the credit to HL-2025-112.
- If you prefer the addendum route instead, Olga is ready to fast-track a 10-business-day extension with a single signature.

I'll attach the credit worksheet and the addendum draft now (attached: POC_Addendum_v2.pdf, SOW-Harmonia.docx). Once we have either PO# or signed addendum we'll mark capacity and notify Eng ops.

Final note: the credit option is valid through COB Monday 11/24 so finance can close month-end bookings. After that we need a signed addendum for timeboxed extensions because capacity planning for December will be locked.

Best —
Kimberly Park

kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
